definitions.flagged.found_in_pool: Listed URLs that match a pool pull request.
definitions.flagged.listed: Distinct pull request URLs flagged by rules v4 (a non-empty extras list) in results/replay_v4_devABC.json (samples A, B, C) and results/replay_v4_sampleD.json.
definitions.flagged.merged: Flagged pool pull requests that were merged.
definitions.flagged.merged_with_human_inline_comment: Flagged and merged, with at least one human inline comment.
definitions.flagged.merged_with_human_review: Flagged and merged, with at least one human review.
definitions.flagged.merged_with_neither: Flagged and merged, with no human review and no human inline comment.
definitions.flagged.not_in_pool: Listed URLs that match no pool pull request.
definitions.flagged.not_merged: Flagged pool pull requests that were not merged.
definitions.merged: Pool pull requests with merged_at set.
definitions.merged_human_reviewed_only_empty_approva: Merged, with at least one human review, every human review being an empty approval.
definitions.merged_no_human_inline_comment: Merged, and no human inline comment.
definitions.merged_no_human_review: Merged, and no pr_reviews row with user_type 'User' (bot-only reviews and no reviews both land here).
definitions.merged_no_human_review_and_no_human_inli: Merged, no human review and no human inline comment.
definitions.merged_no_human_review_by_anyone_but_the: Merged, and no human review by an account other than the author's (includes the ones with no human review).
definitions.merged_no_human_review_or_inline_comment: Merged, and no human review and no human inline comment by an account other than the author's.
definitions.merged_with_human_review: Merged, and at least one human review.
definitions.pool_prs: Pool pull requests in the group, merged or not.
definitions.shares.merged_human_reviewed_only_empty_: merged_human_reviewed_only_empty_approvals divided by merged_with_human_review, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.shares.merged_no_human_inline_comment: merged_no_human_inline_comment divided by merged, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.shares.merged_no_human_review: merged_no_human_review divided by merged, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.shares.merged_no_human_review_and_no_hum: merged_no_human_review_and_no_human_inline_comment divided by merged, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.shares.merged_no_human_review_by_anyone_: merged_no_human_review_by_anyone_but_the_author divided by merged, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.shares.merged_no_human_review_or_inline_: merged_no_human_review_or_inline_comment_by_anyone_but_the_author divided by merged, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.shares.merged_with_human_review: merged_with_human_review divided by merged, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.time.median_minutes: Median of the timed gaps, in minutes (linear interpolation), rounded to 3 decimals.
definitions.time.merged_within_10_min: Timed pull requests merged 10 minutes or less after creation.
definitions.time.merged_within_60_min: Timed pull requests merged 60 minutes or less after creation.
definitions.time.negative_durations_left_out: Merged pull requests whose merged_at is before created_at; left out.
definitions.time.share_within_10_min: merged_within_10_min divided by timed, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.time.share_within_60_min: merged_within_60_min divided by timed, rounded to 4 decimals.
definitions.time.timed: Merged pull requests with a parseable, non-negative time from created_at to merged_at.
definitions.time.unparseable_left_out: Merged pull requests whose created_at or merged_at did not parse; left out.

not_computed.merged_by_the_authors_own_account: pull_request has none of a merger, merged_by or merged-by-user column (checks.pull_request_columns), so who pressed merge is not in the data. The by_anyone_but_the_author rows are the nearest available figures; they only look at reviews and review comments.
not_computed.no_review_no_inline_comment_no_issue_sty: Needs the pr_comments table, which is not in data/ and is not fetched here. merged_no_human_review_and_no_human_inline_comment is an upper bound for it.

terms.author: pull_request.user, compared with the reviewer's user name ignoring case. For Copilot and Devin the author is the agent's own account, so every human is someone else; for the other agents it is the person who ran the agent.
terms.bot: user_type is 'Bot' (the dataset's marker). A missing user_type is neither human nor bot.
terms.empty approval: A review with state APPROVED whose body is null or only whitespace.
terms.human: A review row in pr_reviews, or an inline comment row in pr_review_comments, whose user_type is 'User'. The dataset's own user_type column is the only marker used; no list of names was made.
terms.human inline comment: At least one pr_review_comments row with user_type 'User' that belongs, through pull_request_review_id = pr_reviews.id, to a review of the pull request.
terms.human review: At least one pr_reviews row of the pull request (pr_id) with user_type 'User', in any state (APPROVED, COMMENTED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, DISMISSED).
terms.pool: Pull requests from eval/replay_aidev.py build_pool: linked to an issue in related_issue, in a repository with a permissive licence, the linked issue a real issue with a non-empty body.
terms.timing: Seconds from pull_request.created_at to merged_at, both ISO-8601 UTC. A negative gap or a value that does not parse is counted and left out of the time figures. 'Within 10 min' and 'within 60 min' include the limit.
